# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 19 Nov 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## Private Market: Sales Surge & Land Bids

- **October 2026 developer sales jump to 1,716 homes, led by Thomson Reserve and Lucerne Grand** - Developers sold 1,716 private homes in October 2026, a 479.7% surge from September's 296 units, marking the highest monthly sales volume since October 2025. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/october-2026-developer-sales/)

- **CapitaLand-led consortium submits S$1.82 billion top bid for Town Hall Link GLS site** - The tender for the Town Hall Link GLS white site closed with two bids, led by a S$1.82 billion offer from a consortium comprising CapitaLand Development, Sing Holdings, Far East Organization and Sino Group. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/jld-town-hall-link-gls-white-site/)

- **Hong Leong-TID JV awarded Orchard Boulevard GLS site at S$1,755 psf ppr** - URA awarded the Orchard Boulevard GLS site to Intrepid Investments and TID Residential for S$181.86 million, or approximately S$1,755 psf ppr. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/hong-leong-tid-jv-top-bids-orchard-boulevard-gls-site-at-s1755-psf-ppr/)

## HDB: Million-Dollar Resale Records & BTO Spotlight

- **238 HDB flats sold for over $1 million in October — one town led with 39 sales** - A record 238 HDB flats transacted at $1 million or more in October 2026, nearly triple the 86 recorded a year ago, with Toa Payoh leading at 39 deals followed by Queenstown with 31. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/238-hdb-flats-sold-s1m-october/)

- **MacPherson Weave BTO flats start from $489K as nearby resale homes exceed $1 million** - A review of the MacPherson Weave BTO highlights its doorstep MRT access, communal spaces and city-fringe location, while nearby resale homes already transact above $1 million. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/macpherson-weave-review-city-fringe-convenience/)

## Rental & Niche Segments

- **Condo rental activity slows in October 2026 as HDB rents continue to climb** - Condo leasing volumes eased further in October while HDB rental volumes held steady, with the approaching year-end holiday season expected to keep overall leasing activity subdued. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/condo-rental-activity-slows-down-in-october-2026-as-hdb-rents-continue-to-climb/)
